counter-reset.title: Counter reset
counter-reset.info:
• Never: counters are never reset automatically.
  • Game: counters reset whenever LP are reset.
  • Match: counters reset at the start or end of a match.

game-reset.title: Game reset
game-reset.info:
Defines when the LP reset modal is displayed.
  • Manual: The modal only opens when triggered explicitly.
  • LP Zero: The modal opens automatically when any player's LP reaches zero.
  • LP Zero (auto): Same as above, but the modal is auto-confirmed without opening, resetting LP immediately.

winner-selection.title: Winner selection
winner-selection.info:
Defines how the winner is assigned in the LP reset modal.
  • Manual: The winner is selected by the user.
  • Auto: The winner is suggested automatically. If Game Reset is also set to LP Zero (auto), the winner is picked and confirmed without any interaction.

match-stop.title: Match stop
match-stop.info:
Defines when the match stop.
  • Manual: Match stop prompt opens when triggered explicitly.
  • Winner found: Match stop prompt opens when a winner is found.
  • Timer ends: Match stop prompt opens when the timer ends.
  • Both: Match stop prompt opens when either the timer ends or a winner is found.

on-startup.title: On startup
on-startup.info:
Defines what happens when the app starts.
  • Restore game: If any game was in progress, its restored.
  • Reset game: Game is reset.

judge-page.title: Card Search
judge-page.info:
All search options:
  • atk: Monster Card attack.
  • def: Monster Card defense.
  • attribute: Monster Card attribute.
  • race: Monster Card type (Dragon, Spellcaster, etc).
  • type: Monster Card type (Normal Monster, Synchro Monster, Fusion Monster, Union Effect Monster, Flip Monster).
  • level: Monster Card level.
  • scale: Pendulum Monster Card scale.
  • archetype: Archetype.

step.000a:
leuDuel comes with many features.
Feel free to stop the tutorial at any time.
step.000b:
This section is used to modify players' life points.
You can customise buttons by holding them, or modify this section in the settings.
step.000c: This is the player's life points count; tapping on it opens the LP Calculator.
step.000d: These icons are used to display the player's win count.
step.000e: This section allows you to control the match and perform most actions.
step.000f:
This is the match timer.
It continues past zero once it expires, but it can also stop the match if you prefer.
step.000g:
The match button controls if the match is started or paused, this button cannot stop the match.
On match start, additional prompts may be required depending on your preferences.
step.000h: The counter page allows you to manage counters on the field layout; they are normally reset on game start.
step.000i: Toolbox includes dice roll and coin flip, previous rolls results are also displayed.
step.000j:
In the ruling page you can look up cards to quickly search for rulings or other info.
Advanced search options are described in the page.
step.000k: You can mute app sounds at any time using this button.
step.000l: During a match, the logs page lists all the Life Points changes that happened, you are free to undo any of them for the current game.
step.000m: You can use the game reset button to reset the player's life points and assign a victory to one.
step.000n:
During a match, you can use the stop button to stop the match entirely.
leuDuel may suggest a potential winner based on win counts - this is purely informative.
step.000o: Outside a match, the stop button will simply reset wins and life points.
step.000p: Finally, the settings button - not available during an active match.
step.000q: The settings page includes some options to customize leuDuel.
step.000r: Duel settings contains all the match-related settings.
step.000s: You can customize life points amount on game start.
step.000t: You can customize number of games in a match, this changes the amount of win indicators and when the winner player is picked.
step.000u:
Duel duration defines the timer for your match, notice that it doesn't end the match automatically.
You can change it using hour, minute and seconds units.
step.000v:
Custom profile allows you to pick a card art and a custom name for you and your opponents.
When enabled, you will be prompted to pick your opponent on match start and these details will be displayed during the match.
step.000w:
When pick random player is enabled, an extra window will appear on match start to randomly select a player using some fun randomisers.
You can still close the window before a result is picked.
step.000x: Gui settings contains settings about app interface, themes and accessibility.
step.000y: If you prefer you can set the app to landscape mode, when enabled you can swap the two players around the screen.
step.000z: You can replace rapid buttons with the calculator (but clicking on LP will no longer open it).
step.00a0: But if you prefer using rapid buttons, you can customize their amount depending on your device and preferences.
step.00b0: Android settings contains settings specific to your Android device, if applicable.
step.00c0: Behaviour settings contain special settings to customise some automation during the match.
step.00d0: Each one has an extensive info to it, they can be really useful.
step.00e0:
And that's it!
Feel free to rewatch this small guide using the [?] button in the top-left of the settings page.
Have fun with leuDuel!
